summary: Tested the Weekly Summary (Ringkasan Mingguan) and Template Dokumen features: backend pytest 9 new tests (8 pass) plus the iteration_1 regression suite (22/22 pass), and Playwright UI tests as the director and as Billy (ops). NO real email was sent by this run: weekly_summary_enabled was set to false before every run/cron call and set back to true afterwards. Weekly preview: director only (opfin/ops get 403 DIRECTOR_ONLY, unauthenticated 401). The period is the previous Mon-Sun in Asia/Jakarta (2026-10-05..2026-10-11; container date is 2026-10-17). TEST_ data dated last week was counted correctly: quotations created +1 (value 2000); the quotation dated 2 weeks ago and the one dated this week were excluded; approved/sent/rejected history inside the period counted +1 each, and the approved entry outside the period was excluded; new contracts +1 (by created_at); expiring<=30d +1 (days_left=10); expired +1; contract with 60 days left not counted. Cash: income 1,000,100 / expense 250,000 / count 3. The voided transaction and transactions dated the day before and the day after the period were excluded, and the start/end boundary days were included. Generated weekly HTML passes _assert_safe_email. Manual run while disabled -> status 'disabled', sent 0. Cron: 401 for no auth, wrong bearer, or token without 'Bearer'; valid bearer -> 200 {accepted:true} fast; duplicate X-Webhook-Id recorded once (cron_runs job=weekly-summary); no email_logs created while disabled. Templates: upload is director only (opfin/ops 403 DIRECTOR_ONLY, unauthenticated 401); invalid category 400; .exe and files without an extension 400; empty file 400; name shorter than 2 chars 422; over 15MB rejected; docx/pdf(upper-case .PDF)/png accepted with correct ext and content_type; storage_path and _id are not exposed. List works for all roles, including category and q filters (filename search). Download: all roles get 200 with identical bytes and an attachment header; unauthenticated 401; unknown id 404. Archive: director toggles it on and off; opfin/ops get 403; archived items are hidden unless include_archived. BUG: downloading a template whose original filename contains non-latin-1 characters returns 500. UI: sidebar-link-template is visible to the director and Billy. Director upload dialog works (file name auto-fills the template name, category select, notes, success toast); the card appears under the 'Kontrak Kerja Sama' heading; cards are grouped by category; the download saved the correct filename; archive hides the card; 'Tampilkan arsip' shows it with 'Pulihkan'; restore and search work. Billy: no archive or show-archived buttons; template-upload-button opens the DIRECTOR ONLY restriction popup (no dialog); Billy can download. Director > Notifikasi Email: weekly-enabled-checkbox toggles with a toast and the state persists after reload; weekly-run-now-button while disabled shows the toast 'Ringkasan mingguan sedang dinonaktifkan.'. Regression: login, dashboard, and the /direktur restriction for Billy all work.

minor.issue: HTTP 500 when original_filename has non-latin-1 characters (e.g. 'Kontrak—Tripartit Ü.pdf' with an em dash, or any emoji/CJK). Backend log: UnicodeEncodeError: 'latin-1' codec can't encode character '\u2014'. The file uploads fine but can never be downloaded, by any role. Fix (routes_extra.py line 205-207): send an ASCII fallback plus RFC 5987: from urllib.parse import quote; ascii_name = name.encode('ascii','ignore').decode() or f'template.{t["ext"]}'; header = f'attachment; filename="{ascii_name}"; filename*=UTF-8\'\'{quote(name)}'. Apply the same check to the document file download endpoint (routes_docs) if it uses the same pattern.

Timezone mismatch: the period is computed in Asia/Jakarta, but history[].at and documents.created_at are UTC ISO strings (now_iso) compared by their date prefix. Actions taken Monday 00:00-06:59 WIB (Sunday UTC) are counted in the previous week, and actions on Monday 00:00-06:59 WIB at the start of the period are missed. Fix: convert the WIB period bounds to UTC datetimes (start 00:00 WIB = previous day 17:00Z) and compare the full ISO timestamps, or parse h['at'] into Jakarta time before comparing.

issues: weekly-run-now-button sends a real email in one click with no confirmation dialog. Consider adding a confirm step (it sends to the director's real address).
The 'disabled' status shows as an error (red) toast. An info/warning style would fit better.
Archive/restore has no confirmation and no success toast (the card just disappears). Add toast.success('Template diarsipkan/dipulihkan').
Download errors show a generic 'Gagal mengunduh file.' The 500 for unicode filenames surfaces this way.

action_items: Fix Content-Disposition in GET /api/templates/{id}/file for non-latin-1 filenames (ASCII fallback + filename*=UTF-8''...); also check the document file download endpoint
Make weekly_data compare UTC timestamps against WIB period bounds converted to UTC (history.at, documents.created_at)
Optional: confirm dialog for weekly-run-now-button; toast on template archive/restore
critical_code_review_comments: routes_extra.upload_template reads the whole file into memory before checking the size (await file.read()). Fine at 15MB, but read in chunks or check the Content-Length header first to avoid memory spikes.

Template validation is by extension only. No magic-byte/content check (e.g. a renamed .exe -> .pdf is accepted). Low risk because only the director uploads and downloads are attachments, but consider a basic signature check.
Templates have no delete API, so test or wrong uploads stay in object storage forever (the 9 test objects from this run are orphaned in storage; the DB rows were removed).
run_weekly_summary has no lock or dedupe for manual runs. A double click or two tabs sends duplicate emails (the button is only disabled while busy in one tab).
weekly_data loops over ALL open quotations and ALL active contracts on every call. Fine for current data volume.
Cron fallback run_id 'weekly-{date}' dedupes per day when X-Webhook-Id is missing. Good.

success_rate.backend: 89% (8/9 new tests; 1 failure = unicode filename download 500) + regression 22/22

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/test_gsb31_weekly_templates.py -n 0 -v (pytest.ini adds -n, so pass -n 0). It sends NO emails (it disables weekly before run/cron and restores it). Then python tests/cleanup_test_data.py, delete db.templates name ^TEST_ and cron_runs _id ^TEST_, and restart the backend. Transaction categories must be from income_categories/expense_categories (e.g. 'Pendapatan Lain' / 'Lainnya'). Container date is 2026-10-17 (Sat), so last week = 2026-10-05..11.
rca of the issue: Unicode download 500: routes_extra.download_template builds Content-Disposition with the raw original_filename. Starlette encodes response headers as latin-1, so any char > U+00FF raises UnicodeEncodeError -> 500. Repro: upload 'Kontrak—Tripartit Ü.pdf' as director, then GET /api/templates/{id}/file. Mitigation: ASCII-sanitized filename plus an RFC 5987 filename* parameter.
